tests.description: Timed check on Dance Styles & Genres

questions.question: Q: List three key technical features that distinguish ballet from contemporary dance.
questions.correctAnswer: Ballet features turnout, pointe work and lifted posture with an emphasis on defying gravity. Contemporary dance uses release technique, floor work and weight into the ground, allowing a more grounded, fluid quality.

questions.question: Q: What are the main elements of hip-hop dance?
questions.correctAnswer: Hip-hop dance encompasses breaking (floor work and spins), locking (sharp freezes between fluid movement), popping (quick muscle contractions) and krumping (intense, expressive chest-pumping movements).

questions.question: Q: How does jazz dance combine different influences?
questions.correctAnswer: Jazz dance blends African rhythmic traditions with American theatrical performance, using syncopation, isolations, high energy and kicks. It has roots in African American social dance and Broadway musical theatre.

questions.question: Q: Why is it important to identify stylistic features in AQA 8236?
questions.correctAnswer: Identifying style features allows students to accurately describe and analyse prescribed professional works, demonstrating understanding of how choreographers use style to communicate intention and create meaning.

questions.question: Q: Give an example of fusion in dance and explain its effect.
questions.correctAnswer: Matthew Bourne's Swan Lake blends classical ballet technique with contemporary and theatrical storytelling, replacing the traditional female corps with male dancers. This fusion creates a fresh interpretation that challenges conventions while retaining ballet's technical demands.
